feature-board-summary-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → E faaali mai e le Aotelega mea na faia e tagata taitoatasi i le laupapa i le aso po o le vaiaso mulimuli, ma mea ua tuai.

feature-search-phrases-desc: E malamalama le suʻesuʻega lautele i fuaitau faigofie e pei o "oʻu kata ua tuai".
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → Talu mai lau asiasiga mulimuli e faaali mai mea na suia e isi i le laupapa.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalena ma le kalena mo laupapa e tele.
feature-views-chat-desc: O le laupapa o se avanoa talanoaga: avanoa faigaluega, laupapa, ala, lisi ma pepa o se laau o alalaupapa, o le pepa i le ogatotonu ma ana faamatalaga o feʻau talanoaga.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: O pepa lava ia i ni seti o koluma e tele ua faaigoaina - e tusa ma le maeaina, faamuamua, maata po o se isi lava mea - e siitia i le va o koluma e ala i le toso.
feature-views-email-desc: O le laupapa o se pusameli: o le lisi imeli o le Pusa o mai, o lisi o faila, o igoa faailoga o igoa faailoga, ma tusi ma tali e sui imeli mai le tuatusi o le laupapa.
feature-views-flow-charts: Siata o le faagasologa o galuega
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Galuega o totoe, galuega ua mae'a, faagasologa ua tuufaatasia, taimi o le taamilosaga ma le taimi mai le talosaga i le mae'a, aofaiga o galuega ua mae'a, taimi ua faatali ai galuega, faalavelave, Monte Carlo ma isi fua o le faagasologa.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Vaaiga e tolu o siata Gantt.
feature-views-map-desc: Pepa e pei o faailoga i luga o se ata ua lafo i luga.
feature-views-overview-desc: Fuainumera, faavasegaina e tusa ma le tagata ua tofia i ai, fuafuaga o galuega, laupapa mataitu ma le laupapa tele.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Galuega o le oloa o loo faatali, vaitaimi pupuu o galuega, lipoti o le vaitaimi ma le saoasaoa o galuega.
feature-views-table-desc: Le laupapa o se laulau o pepa e mafai ona faavasega.
feature-views-time-desc: Taimi ma le laina o taimi.
feature-views-version-control: Vaaiga o le puleaina o lomiga
feature-views-version-control-desc: O le laupapa e pei o se su'esu'ega o fa'afitauli a GitHub po'o Gitea: pepa o fa'afitauli, igoa faailoga ma fa'ailoga taua, faamatalaga o le talanoaga, faapipiiga o faila, ma le talafaasolopito o le laupapa ma le toe faaleaogaina.
